title: Veggie Sausage, Apple & Goat Cheese Pita Pizza with Arugula Salad

steps.text: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions).

Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
While the pitas bake, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.

Layer baked pitas with apple and sausage slices, then crumble goat cheese over top. Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, halve, and slice cucumber into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Divide pita pizzas between plates and sprinkle with basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
